integrity: The proof uses the exact supporting-functional criterion at smooth points and symbolic exponent reduction. No finite search, numerical sample, or inaccessible source is used as proof; inaccessible literature is retained only as an explicit residual bibliographic risk.
scientific_limitations: The reciprocity formula is proved on the smooth ordered sector for 1<q<infinity and 0<omega<=1. It is sufficient for the global Radon classification but does not classify nonsmooth endpoint exponents q=1 or q=infinity, nor all reciprocal pairs on axes and diagonal seams.
title: Birkhoff reciprocity locus and Radon rigidity of two-dimensional Lorentz sequence spaces
